bifrost: No app-facing record-sync SDK. Local pieces: springboard/sdk/src/defaults.rs, keychain.rs, share.rs, url.rs; ~/Projects/bifrost-cloud (server-side contacts/calendar sync)
summary: BifrOSt has no generic record database, subscriptions or sync engine for apps. The cloud service in bifrost-cloud syncs contacts and calendar over ETag/If-Match HTTP APIs, and the shell backs up data to a local file.

The signed-in user's identity (record name, display name, sign-up address, admin flag) is read from the cloud answer to GET /me and mapped to typed errors, tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-rest-07.rs. Gap: the service has no lookup by address, so an app cannot discover another user, and the caller performs the request. Checked 2026-10-17: nothing to build in BifrOSt until bifrost-cloud has a lookup route; that change belongs to the server repo.

features.note: The archive format, its checksums, the name rules, restore and the staged restore are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-15.rs. Backup is local only and export is a file in the data directory; there is no delete action and the keychain has no iCloud sync (docs/bifrost-ui.md). Built 2026-10-17: delete_backups removes only the backup-<unix>.sbk archives and keeps the live data; tests shell::backup::tests::delete_removes_only_backup_archives. Still partial: no Settings action yet, and the archive is not encrypted (needs a key decision and an audited AEAD crate).
